module.title: Fergus
module.description: Connect Fergus and Sync Jobs with Platform Projects

integration.description: Connect to Fergus for Job Management and Project Sync.

pat.label: Personal Access Token
pat.instructions: Generate a Personal Access Token in Fergus under Settings → Integrations → Fergus API. Paste the token below to connect without OAuth app registration.

token.label: Personal Access Token
token.placeholder: Paste Your Fergus Personal Access Token

oauth.label: OAuth 2.0
oauth.instructions: Enter your Fergus OAuth client ID and client secret from a registered Fergus application. After saving, you will be redirected to Fergus to sign in and authorize this application. Tokens are stored and refreshed automatically.

client-id.label: Client ID
client-id.placeholder: Paste Your Fergus OAuth Client ID

client-secret.label: Client Secret
client-secret.placeholder: Paste Your Fergus OAuth Client Secret

connect.instructions: Choose an Auth Method, then fill the required fields. Prefer a Fergus Personal Access Token from Settings → Integrations → Fergus API, or use OAuth Client ID and Client Secret from a registered Fergus application.

group.title: Fergus
group.description: Configure Fergus Integration and Job Links

not-connected.title: Connect Fergus to Import Jobs
not-connected.message: Fergus is not connected for this tenant. Open Administration → Integrations to connect your account, then try importing again.
